description: PRO ASYL documents the adjusted protection rate (bereinigte Schutzquote) for Iran falling from 45% in 2023 to 37% in 2024 to 27% in 2025. Three-quarters of substantively examined Iranian claims were rejected in 2025.
source_name: PRO ASYL policy paper on Iran decisions

description: Positive decisions ran at 30% for women and 25% for men - a five-point gap, with both far below the rate of a few years earlier.
energy_note: A measurable male penalty, in a published figure.
notes: One of the very few places a male-specific disadvantage is actually quantified in official-derived data. High value.

description: PRO ASYL identifies: questionable distinctions between protest organisers and participants; unclear reasoning about what exit from Iran was possible; and dismissal of sexualised violence as 'alleged isolated incidents'.
German courts corrected BAMF decisions thousands of times in 2025, granting protection contrary to the original rejection. For Iranian applicants the overturn rate was around 54% in 2023.
time_note: An appeal adds years on top of the original wait.
energy_note: Right eventually, after years - if you can fund the appeal.

description: The organisation describes a stark contradiction - 'mass arrests, torture, sexualized violence, and increasing executions' intensifying in 2025-2026 while approval rates fell - and suggests quotas may be 'deliberately kept low for domestic political reasons'.
notes: This is an advocacy organisation's interpretation, clearly labelled as such. The underlying rates are BAMF data.

description: Germany's overall protection rate fell from 51.7% (2023) to 44.4% (2024) to 28.1% (2025). Iran fell faster than the average.

aspect: SCENARIO - rejected, then granted on appeal, three years later
description: Reza's asylum claim is rejected by BAMF in 2024: the reasoning distinguishes protest organisers from participants and places him in the second group. He appeals. In 2027 the administrative court grants protection. He has spent three years unable to work at his profession, and has been right the whole time.
energy_note: Vindicated, three years after it would have helped.
